name: Jewel Boom Super Drop
review:
About as simple as it gets: a single 3x1 line, styled like a one-armed bandit, with gems and golden chests on a shiny gold grid.

The Collector Bonus is the main event – collect diamonds to unlock one of five jackpots. Medium-low volatility, a 3,000x max and 96.5% RTP. Quick to learn and quick to play, perfect for short demo sessions. It did well enough to get a follow-up, Bling Blitz Diamond Drop.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
